CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2636 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 328e222fe8d3b4fe92ad9e37724fcc62bad55da8. Bus nonce: e881976bd7e564ebf68a0268f794f870. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 328e222fe8d3b4fe92ad9e37724fcc62bad55da8`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 328e222fe8d3b4fe92ad9e37724fcc62bad55da8` or `Fix review: blocked 328e222fe8d3b4fe92ad9e37724fcc62bad55da8 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: e881976bd7e564ebf68a0268f794f870`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2636 328e222fe8d3b4fe92ad9e37724fcc62bad55da8") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2636-e881976b`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, PR #2636 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS: ban Claude attribution footers and session links in seat output (tvofi 2026-10-22). Head 328e222fe8d3b4fe92ad9e37724fcc62bad55da8. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Check:
1. The source arm. .claude/settings.json attribution keys (commit "", pr "", sessionUrl false) match the settings reference's types, and the file still loads on the versions the body names.
2. The check arm. tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs --pr-body refuses a Generated-with footer, a Co-Authored-By Claude trailer and a session link, each alone and together, with one "tool's attribution" error and no "does not parse". A clean body passes (null). Mutate the refusal (drop each pattern) and show the corresponding tests/entities.py pin and the tools/pr/prepr.sh self-test go red.
3. Over-firing. Run the lint over main's recent merged PR bodies or a census, and check that no legitimate text (the word "Claude" in prose, a docs URL, a non-session claude.ai link) is refused. Report the false-positive count with its denominator.
4. The merge resolution in tests/entities.py (the _FRICTION_TRAILER / none_plus_session rows) keeps both sides' meaning.
5. The body's figures at this head: self-test counts, agreement items, session-trailer census, and the Red checks section (the predicted policy-docs red). Read CI on this head from check-runs.
6. Policy approval. This touches policy (.claude/settings.json and the lint). Say whether it is policy under CLAUDE.md, so the orchestrator can approve under the mandate at merge.

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
